QuestInfo.name: Light Barrier
QuestInfo.0: What did Vieren think of? Ask him.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Cursed Temple near Sleepywood and find the crystal needed for the Light Barrier. The Rememberer in Sleepywood might be able to help.
QuestInfo.2: Go to the Cursed Temple near Sleepywood and find the crystal needed for the Light Barrier. The Rememberer in Sleepywood might be able to help.

1.0: What do you seek?\r\n#L0##bI am here to find the crystal to make the Light Barrier. I hear I can get them around here.#l\n#k
1.1: The Light Barrier... Not many people know of this. You can get the crystals at the #bCursed Temple#k.\r\n#L0##bThe Cursed Temple?#l\n#k
1.2: That's correct. Talk to the #bInsignificant Being#k in front of the temple for more.

npc.0: I'd imagine #bThe Rememberer#k would know about the crystal.
